channel_findings.constants: The same avatar on 20 of 20: same man, same short black hair, same red polo shirt every time. White and yellow are the only text colours. Bright, clean, high-key home interiors.
channel_findings.host_treatment: The avatar is never a pasted cut-out with an outline: he is generated inside the scene, lit by the room, and he always does something with his hands (pinches his nose, points at tile 3, holds a toilet roll, opens a cupboard, shrugs at the mess). Head and shoulders to waist up, face about 15 to 25 % of frame width in the grid format and 25 to 35 % in the newer scene format. Always at the camera. Same outfit is the brand mark: there is no logo or badge.
channel_findings.text_rules: 4 to 6 words, one line, lower case, rounded bold sans (Poppins or Montserrat class), white with the last one or two words in yellow, soft drop shadow. Conversational and blunt: this is why you smell, stop buying this sh*t. The numbered tiles do the listing so the text can stay a feeling. Newer thumbnails switch to 2 to 4 word caps in black and yellow boxes.
channel_findings.popular_vs_latest: All 9 of the best performers with known views use the numbered grid. The latest 10 dropped the grid for one big messy-room scene with a larger face and boxed caps. 9 of the latest 10 have no public view count in the feed, so this study cannot say whether the change helped.
channel_findings.top3: 1 (660,000), 2 (457,000), 3 (417,000): all numbered grids with the avatar reacting or pointing and a lower-case line ending in yellow.
transfer: Lock the avatar's outfit. One shirt on every thumbnail does the job of a logo: 20 of 20.
Generate the avatar inside the scene with his hands doing something tied to the subject, never a floating head: 1, 2, 3, 7, 18.
Give his hands one job per thumbnail: point at the proof or react to it: 3, 8, 10, 14.
Two text colours only, with the payoff word in the second colour: 1 to 10, 19, 20.
A numbered proof grid only fits list videos; a single-event documentary has no list, so this part does not transfer.
channel_findings.weak: 7: ten tiny tiles and a thin text strip, unreadable at small size. 17: red circles and arrows everywhere, nothing to look at first. 9: collage with no single subject.
